name: WORLD_CORE_V17_V18_FOUNDATION_REVIEWED_NONPRODUCTION

independent_review.scope: V17-V18 package-scoped pure Core household and fiscal foundation candidate only
independent_review.limit: This is not approval of a V17 or V18 product, Gate, hard-dependency path, merge, deployment, or production action.

review_remediation: Commitment lineage is immutable, predecessor-linked, and rejects caller-owned committed-before balances.
Settlement, payment, and commitment evidence binds source/version/snapshot/hash/predecessor lineage and a canonical replay preimage.
Household settlement kinds and Treasury insufficient-cash dispositions are runtime-validated.

final_foundation_integration.scope: Accepted only as a reviewed non-production input to the separately governed final V11-V18 pure-Core foundation integration.
conditions: A later integration change must preserve the exact source provenance and re-run combined integration checks.
The V09 quarantine and all Core boundary restrictions remain in force.
This acceptance does not satisfy, bypass, or reclassify any R2 normal-mode dependency.

hard_dependencies.effect: Unchanged. This policy does not approve, satisfy, bypass, or reclassify any dependency.

preserved_boundaries: V17 and V18 remain FOUNDATION_REVIEWED_NONPRODUCTION, not VERIFIED.
No V17 or V18 product integration, Gate readiness, lifecycle-state transition, or dependency-path approval is claimed.
No status/progress or Gate record is changed.
No database, RLS, migration, API, worker, UI, Command, Event, authoritative state, transaction, production, merge, or deployment action is authorized.
No financial, treasury, household, price, priority, default, poverty, cost, or macro-policy formula is selected.
V09.3 remains the owner of durable atomic commit, idempotency, writer coordination, and recovery evidence.
